title: Change Dataset Properties for a Power BI Telemetry App in Power BI

chapters.title: Locating the Business Central Telemetry workspace

features.name: Power BI Telemetry app dataset properties
features.description: Ability to change dataset properties for a Power BI Telemetry app in Power BI, including data source credentials and refresh rate configuration.

features.name: Data source credentials management
features.description: Ability to change who is refreshing the dataset and update data source credentials through the settings menu in Power BI.

features.name: Report refresh rate configuration
features.description: Ability to set how often a Power BI report should refresh and configure notifications for refresh errors.
